summary: Free local plugin for coding agents that keeps large tool output out of the context window, saving tokens.

heroCommands.command:
claude plugin marketplace add mksglu/context-mode
claude plugin install context-mode@context-mode

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Context Mode is a free, local plugin for 11 coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Qwen Code. When your agent reads files, runs commands or fetches pages, the plugin processes the output in a sandbox so only the relevant part reaches the agent's context window.
sixtySeconds.problem: Every tool result fills the agent's context, which costs tokens and pushes out earlier work. Context Mode cuts that down; the README's live examples show over 96% of raw bytes kept out of context.
whoFor: Heavy users of Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI
Developers working with large files and web pages
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a local plugin that keeps usage data on your machine, with hooks, MCP and skills support across many agents.
requirements: On Windows, Git for Windows (tools run in Git Bash)

overview: Pick your agent's install block in the README. For Claude Code, add the marketplace and install the plugin; similar commands exist for Codex, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code and others. Each block also shows update, check and remove steps.
After installing, paste one of the README's example prompts, then run the stats skill to see how much context was saved.
The plugin is free and its source is on GitHub under the Elastic License 2.0. Context Mode Gateway is a separate hosted service with its own subscription.
